protocol.surface_mapping: each sampled field min/max normalised independently to a shared peak-to-trough relief; not equal slope, spectrum or basin structure
protocol.random_surface: independent heights at grid vertices joined into triangles; not discontinuous white noise at every real coordinate
protocol.worley_surface: FastNoiseLite cellular, Euclidean distance, RETURN_DISTANCE, no fractal; normalised sampled F1; not cell IDs or boxes
protocol.release: same 4 by 8 tray-local grid, normal height 1.1m, same radius/mass/zero velocity; gravity remains world vertical
outcomes: still inside when observation window ended
future_receivers: line-of-sight with fixed observer and target heights
local optimiser with stated objective, sampler and stopping rule
do_not_infer: permanent trapping from a finite deadline
global impossibility from a local optimiser failure

route.question: Where does a local downhill rule take you?
route.carry: One update can finish in unequal valleys from different beginnings.
route.next_action: Carry the distinction between a numerical position update and physical motion into every terrain trial.
route.status: Existing controlled primary; no physical tray added to this hall.

route.question: When does repetition direct or obstruct a body?
route.carry: The existing visible walls suggest a passage without colliding.
route.next_action: Place and verify a compact physical sine tray as a supporting comparison; keep the corridor primary. Inspect the existing basin and circulation before choosing its location.
route.status: Next museum integration: the new bench is currently a standalone workshop.

route.question: What does a relationship between neighbouring heights change?
route.carry: The existing white/Perlin column comparison makes independent and correlated samples visible.
route.next_action: Repeat the sphere trial with independent vertex heights, then a shared sampled field; declare triangular versus stepped surfaces.
route.status: Proposed physical receiver extension; existing comparison retained.

route.question: What changes when variation is layered?
route.carry: The current encounter is a texture mixer, despite the room name.
route.next_action: Use as a cross-reference for scale and normalisation; do not promise a walkable random landscape here.

route.question: What becomes a route, and for which body?
route.carry: The existing heightfield supplies collision, but entry and controls require placement review.
route.next_action: Freeze seed/start/goal and review a real player route; compare it with sphere passage and measured line-of-sight. Add Perlin/cellular choices only through explicit tested controls.
route.status: Walkability and concealment comparison proposed, not demonstrated by the bench.

route.question: Which difference belongs to the generator and which to its presentation?
route.carry: The paired displays already declare matching settings; shared seed does not mean identical features.
route.next_action: Compare a continuous Worley F1 surface with a stepped/cell-labelled rendering separately. Keep normalisation and sampling visible.
route.status: Existing paired primaries retained; cellular extension still proposed.

route.question: Who supplied the meaning of a good arrival?
route.carry: The current comparator scores slope/intercept of a line under different losses.
route.next_action: Return to the terrain experiment explicitly: axes now mean model parameters, height means loss. Inspect training versus held-out evaluation before promising generalisation controls.
route.status: Existing loss comparator is the return point; source/runtime review still required.
